body.name: fixed-support minimax transition handle
body.construction: Within \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{reg}}\), the support is the fixed known rectangle union \(H\) and \(f_{XZ}\ge f_0>0\) on \(H\), so a shrinking conditional-support hole is not an admissible path. Study minimax excess-endpoint risk along fixed-support sequences of laws \(P\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{reg}}\) satisfying \(\mathcal C_P\neq\varnothing\), along which \(R(P)\to0\), by constructing and verifying Le Cam two-point or Assouad families of \(\beta\)-H\"older perturbations of \(g\) and/or \(\nu_P\) that preserve every class restriction and compatibility and separate the optimized endpoints of \(\Theta(P)\). A support-topology transition must instead be posed on a separately defined varying-support triangular-array class with explicit geometry and density conditions. This handle asserts no lower bound.
